dispositions.decision: A real unstructured ordinary-conversation ingress and egress cannot be proven safe while the minimum OPSEC match/redaction contract is unavailable. Blocking every protected route is insufficient because a natural-language request can seek protected source reproduction inside the ordinary lane.
dispositions.fail_closed_behavior: Before the minimum policy exists, no real user turn may reach the local model. Test fixtures may exercise downstream contracts only.
dispositions.next_required_packet: Protected Security Phase 1 Minimum OPSEC Match and Redaction Contract

dispositions.decision: Phase 1 exposes no protected action and performs no Auth evaluation. Missing evidence classes and thresholds never downgrade to model judgment.
dispositions.fail_closed_behavior: Any authorization-required action returns UNAVAILABLE without attempt.

dispositions.decision: Resolved for Phase 1 by the one-route ordinary_conversation catalog in readiness/phase1_executable_slice.json. All slash, protected, tool, source, artifact, scheduling, continuity-mutation, and Program routes are unsupported.
Natural-language claim-to-source tooling is not required for ordinary background conversation. No source_only route exists in Phase 1.
Model-provider observations carry observed_at, valid_until, scope, limitations, and evidence refs. Unknown or stale required evidence is UNAVAILABLE. Other providers remain outside Phase 1.
Phase 1 terminal host delivery and LM Studio completion receipts are bounded here. Chat/Codex delivery, artifacts, time, scheduling, and tools remain host-specific and unclaimed.
Resolved at the generic continuity-contract level by BC-030. Phase 1 selects an unavailable continuity provider and ordinary turn-local conversation does not require durable continuity.
No mood/profile storage enters Phase 1; Persona alone supplies expression.
No classroom state or School Engine enters Phase 1; teaching remains model-facing.
Resolved sufficiently for implementation readiness by explicit dispositions for UR-001 through UR-028 in readiness/implementation_gap_dispositions.json.
Phase 1 performs no cross-turn protected authorization, publishes no attempt values, and issues no pending authorization request.
dispositions.fail_closed_behavior: Protected continuation is UNAVAILABLE and no new request is synthesized.

dispositions.decision: Generic host-evidence requirements remain intact, but no Chat, Codex, Python terminal, or LM Studio surface is claimed to provide protected continuation. Ordinary conversation does not depend on it.

non_blocker_rule: SUR-002, SUR-011, and SUR-012 block protected features only because Phase 1 exposes no protected operation or continuation. SUR-003 and SUR-010 are resolved for the finite slice.
